integrity: Theorem proved analytically; exact-rational symbolic checker corroborates identities and stable examples. Prior logit cancellation and existence of stable boundary equilibria are expressly credited; historical priority remains literature-bounded.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic three-variable unit-timescale system with strictly interior initial data; no classification of basins or convergence to a single equilibrium. At feedback equality only qualitative boundary-union attraction. Does not cover the alternate cost-to-risk feedback dynamics.
title: A sharp universal boundary-saturation rate in adaptive collective-risk games
